record.oneLiner: Work management platform with a RESTful API for tasks, projects and workspaces.
record.verdictReason: Personal access tokens are generated in the developer console and OAuth is documented, with no review step stated. Breadth is judged from the reference scope, not from a full endpoint audit, so treat broad as provisional.

evidence.quote: A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
PATs are generated in the developer console.
The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs
Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
